limitations: All 12 crops contain reference points; repeated/overlapping crops across five records are not independent.
Record points do not define feature extents or establish visible surviving remains; proximity is not identification, precision or recall.
No verified negative controls or independently annotated visible landmark boundaries; no general survey accuracy estimate.
Different fresh workers and one run per arm: reviewer variation and richer image budget are confounded with input changes. No attribution to a single added layer.
Procedural blinding, not technical filesystem isolation; outputs checked for obvious place/record strings.
No live inventory, publication, field or original full-resolution point-cloud verification performed by reviewers.
